title: Onye a chụpụrụ n'ogige ahụ
intro: Otu ihe omimi bibu n'ọkwa kachasị elu nke ihe e kere eke, nke dị nso na Chineke karịa ka ọtụtụ mmadụ nwere ike ịghọta. Ma mpako malitere ịgba mgbọrọgwụ, otu omume nnupụisi gbanwere ụzọ ndụ. Ugbu a, nke a na-awagharị dị ka onye iro a ṅụrụ iyi, na-asụ ngọngọ ma na-eme atụmatụ ruo mgbe ụbọchị nkwa ga-eru. Ị nwere ike ịchọpụta njirimara nke onye a dara ada a?
clues: E nwere mgbe m so n'ime ndị kacha dịrị Chineke nso, ndị e buliri elu karịa ihe e kere eke.
E ji ihe na-ekpo ọkụ kee m, ọ bụghị site n'ala ma ọ bụ ụrọ.
Mgbe e nyere m iwu ka m kpọọ isiala n'ihu ihe e kere ọhụrụ, ekweghị m — nke mere ka m chee na ọ bụ ihe m ji mara onwe m.
A chụpụrụ m ma bụrụ onye a bụrụ ọnụ, mana n'ikpeazụ enyere m oge izu ike ruo oge a maara, nke a kara aka.
Ekwere m nkwa iduhie ọtụtụ mmadụ dịka m nwere ike, na-abịaru ụmụ Adam nso site n'akụkụ niile.
Abụ m onye iro a kpọrọ aha nke ụmụ mmadụ niile, na-akpa nkata ma na-asụ ngọngọ mgbe niile ruo mgbe a kara aka.

trial.label: Nnwale / Ihe Omume
options: Ịrụ nwa ehi ọlaedo ka ndị mmadụ fee ofufe
Ikewa oké osimiri site na mkpara
Ibu ocheeze Eze Nwanyị Sheba n'otu ntabi anya

outcome.label: Nsonaazụ
options: E nyere ezumike ruo ụbọchị ikpe
Mmiri riri ya n'oké osimiri ya na ndị agha
E liri ya ndụ n'okpuru obí eze dara ada
Agbanweela ka ọ bụrụ enwe ma ọ bụ enwe
E buliri ya elu n'ọkwa dị elu
outcome.answer: E nyere ezumike ruo ụbọchị ikpe

arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ بِمَآ أَغْوَيْتَنِى لَأُزَيِّنَنَّ لَهُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَأُغْوِيَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
verse: [Iblees] said, "My Lord, because You have put me in error, I will surely make [disobedience] attractive to them [i.e., mankind] on earth, and I will mislead them all (15:39)
